name: Tamiyo, Field Researcher
oracle_text:
+1: Choose up to two target creatures. Until your next turn, whenever either of those creatures deals combat damage, you draw a card.
−2: Tap up to two target nonland permanents. They don't untap during their controller's next untap step.
−7: Draw three cards. You get an emblem with "You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs."
blocked_sentences: −7: Draw three cards. You get an emblem with "You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs."

needs.what: a zone restriction on the `free_cast_permission` static (e.g. `zones: ["hand"]`, or a `zone` key in its `affects_spells` filter) so the free cast line is offered only for spells cast from their caster's hand -- Tamiyo's emblem and Omniscience both say "from your hand"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: free_cast_permission is asked inside casting._cast_options, which every cast lane calls -- hand, command zone (commander), adventure exile, grant_playable exile/graveyard, graveyard-cast permissions -- so it frees spells from every zone; its affects_spells takes SPELL_FILTER_KEYS only, which has no zone key. Written as-is the emblem would also cast your commander, flashback-style graveyard casts and exiled 'you may play' cards for free, a strictly better card than printed. The +1 (delayed_trigger until_your_next_turn on deals_combat_damage with a multi-object subject) and the −2 (tap + skip_untap) are now expressible.
